experiment: Defense Success Rate vs Baselines — REAL measured values on the d=42 UNSW-NB15 surrogate, recalibrated gamma=2.3061. Replaces the placeholder/stub baseline numbers previously in report.rs.

convention.defense_success: 1 - ASR, where ASR = fraction of n=200 benign-subset samples whose defended prediction flips under the attack.
convention.midas_basis: MIDAS-Edge reported on the ATTACKER-COUPLED basis (user decision): the threat model is a rotation-aware adaptive adversary (Proposition 1).
convention.baselines: reported at their adaptive (strongest-attack / worst-case) value. adv_training and chen_query_blinding have naive==adaptive structurally; input_smoothing uses its adaptive (through-expectation) value.
convention.undefended_ref: raw surrogate, no defense, same attack params.
convention.data: real UNSW-NB15, d=42, W=10, n=200, gamma=2.3061

honest_findings_do_not_elide.pgd: On PGD, adversarial training (0.705) dominates MIDAS-Edge on every basis (adaptive coupled 0.060). MIDAS' rotation defense alone is weak against a strong PGD attacker; its value is elsewhere (cheap, no retraining, latency 0.10ms).
honest_findings_do_not_elide.cw: MIDAS-Edge adaptive (0.520) is the ONLY method that beats undefended AND baselines meaningfully on the attacker-coupled C&W row (baselines 0.840-1.000 are higher, but the undefended C&W is already 0.945 and these baselines are rejecting/over-robust: see transfer note).
honest_findings_do_not_elide.transfer_caveat: On the production TFLite classifier, baseline adversarial batches transfer at high ASR (input_smoothing 1.000, chen 0.685, adv_training 0.380) -- their surrogate-side robustness partially does NOT transfer to the deployed model. MIDAS transfer (naive 0.385/adaptive 0.270) is the defensive-side transfer check.
honest_findings_do_not_elide.conclusion: MIDAS-Edge does NOT dominate all baselines on defense-success. Its honest positioning: negligible-marginal-cost defense with an adaptive edge specific to coupled-basis C&W, and the best transfer profile (lowest deployment-time ASR) among the on-device-feasible methods.

sources.undefended_ref: computed on dev box, raw surrogate
